title: Meta Expert: Cross-Layer Expert Sharing for Storage- and Retrieval-Efficient MoE
abstract: arXiv:2610.27598v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As model parameters scale up, sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches have become essential for model scaling. However, mainstream models currently adopt hierarchical architectures, where experts in different layers, although topologically independent, exhibit substantial similarity and redundancy in their stored content. Compared to the hierarchically arranged \textbf{Local Expert} in existing mainstream models, we hypothesize that inter-layer shared \textbf{Meta Expert} hold greater potential. To this end, we conduct a multi-dimensional empirical comparison between Local and Meta Experts, and find that models incorporating Meta Experts exhibit lower parameter redundancy, together with lower cross-entropy loss and higher downstream task accuracy. translated_title: 元专家：面向存储与检索高效MoE的跨层专家共享
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.27598v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：随着模型参数规模不断扩大，稀疏激活的混合专家方法已成为模型扩展的关键手段。然而，目前主流模型采用分层架构，其中不同层的专家虽然在拓扑上相互独立，但其存储内容却表现出显著的相似性与冗余性。与现有主流模型中分层排列的“局部专家”相比，我们假设层间共享的“元专家”具有更大的潜力。为此，我们对局部专家与元专家进行了多维度的实证比较，发现引入元专家的模型具有更低的参数冗余，同时交叉熵损失更低、下游任务准确率更高。在激活专家数量与专家粒度保持不变的情况下，我们的模型仅需70%–80%的专家即可达到与原始MoE相当的性能，从而显著降低……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出跨层共享的“元专家”架构以替代传统各层独立的局部专家，在保持与原始MoE相当性能的前提下，仅需70%–80%的专家数量，显著降低了MoE模型的参数冗余及存储与检索开销。
